description: Problem: the reports list text and failures that no test reached, and nobody has decided whether any is worth the spend: (1) the global file's delegation rule is 'keep, untested' because no session delegated in any arm; (2) nine of ten sections of BenchBox's AGENTS.md, and the agent files of benchbox-site, Oxbow and textcharts, are untested; (3) many real turns could not be replayed (omp exit 3 with no error text), which limits replay coverage; (4) the false review credit, where agents credited reviews to a tool they never ran, recurred in every replay arm and has no test of a fix; (5) the skills not covered by any round: docs, blog, substack, benchbox. Outcome: a recorded owner decision per entry: test it (a new item is filed with its own gate, rubric and guardrails), or leave it untested with the reason. Decision gate: the owner decides each entry. Before asking, attach to each a one-paragraph estimate: what scenario or replay it needs, sessions, cost from the reports' per-session figures, and what decision the result could change. An entry whose result could change nothing while deletions are off the table is recommended as 'leave'. Guardrails: this item runs no paid sessions and changes no instruction text or report; it files items only for entries the owner chose; it does not reopen the dropped GPT Sol work.
